description: The main window may read the tracker status and the match library, ask for match thumbnails, cut a clip out of a saved match's recording, mark a clip as a favorite, show a clip in Explorer, send a clip to the Recycle Bin, copy a clip to the clipboard, save a copy of a clip where the user picks, mark a match as a favorite, show a match's video in Explorer, see the storage and the cleanup's dry run, change the cleanup's settings, run it, let it retry a video, look at an Outplayed library and import it by reference, let the cleanup remove an import's videos, and receive updates. Nothing else.
